column1: # Environment variables that move where an agent or a tool keeps its folders. An account run in fleet
# mode does not run the person's shell or PowerShell profiles, so a variable set only there is not
# followed: the run reads each profile as text, never runs it, and leaves the account partly checked
# when one sets a variable below. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   name     the variable, as the agent or tool reads it
#   kind     agent: it moves an agent's own folders; tool: an npm or Python tool's folder. Either
#            counts only when set to somewhere other than a folder the check reads when it is not
#            set (an installer can write that default into a profile).
#   sh       those folders for gird-check.sh, separated by ;, from ~, or - for none.
#   windows  those folders for gird-check.ps1, which counts any variable set to one of them as not
#            moved: from ~, {LOCALAPPDATA} or {APPDATA}, or - for none.
#   scripts  the tool's own scripts in its folder, which neither script reads when a profile sources
#            them from there: each sets the tool's variable to the folder it is in. - for none.
